description: Image Description: The image shows an open oven embedded within a white wooden cabinet, with its door ajar and the interior illuminated by a warm, golden light. Inside the oven, a single loaf of bread is baking on the middle rack, positioned centrally and glowing from the heat. The bread has a golden-brown crust and appears to be in the final stages of baking. The oven's interior features a glass door, through which the bread is clearly visible, and metal racks that are evenly spaced.
